newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Index falls amid slow trade at Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Index falls amid slow trade at Estonian bourse.

text.p: The index fell amid a slow day of trading at Estonia's fledgling bourse, dealers said.
Overall market volume was just 4.7 million kroons and the index fell by 0.12 percent to 105.64.
Tallinn bank was the most active listing at 1.3 million kroons, closing at 39.90 kroons compared with 40.20 kroons on Friday.
Turnover on the free-market amounted to 3.8 million kroons.
